topics.title: Descriptive Statistics: Central Tendency & Dispersion
topics.objective: Calculate mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, and interquartile ranges.
topics.exercise: Calculate the 5-number summary and standard deviation for a dataset with outliers.

topics.title: Probability Distributions (Normal, Binomial, Poisson)
topics.objective: Understand probability density functions, z-scores, and the Central Limit Theorem.
topics.exercise: Compute the probability of an outcome occurring within 2 standard deviations under a normal curve.

topics.title: Hypothesis Testing & Null Hypothesis Significance
topics.objective: Formulate H0 and H1 hypotheses, select significance alpha levels, and calculate p-values.
topics.exercise: Perform a two-sample t-test to determine if a website redesign significantly increased conversions.

topics.title: Confidence Intervals & Margin of Error
topics.objective: Construct and interpret 95% confidence intervals for population means and proportions.
topics.exercise: Calculate a 95% confidence interval for customer satisfaction survey response averages.

topics.title: Linear Regression & Correlation Coefficients
topics.objective: Calculate Pearson r correlation and interpret slope, intercept, and R-squared variance.
topics.exercise: Fit a simple linear regression line to advertising spend and sales revenue data.
